data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-b-r meaning 'to return' or 'to give'. Huboor can be interpreted as a 'gift', 'reward', or 'blessing'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that children are a gift from Allah and a blessing to their parents. The name Huboor carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huboor usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
